Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were
involved in while turning left in Conroe. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand.
Q: Please state your full name and the address where you currently live.
A: I'd rather keep those details off the record for now, but I can confirm I'm the driver of the vehicle that was involved.
Q: That's fine for the moment. Can you walk me through what happened before the impact?
A: I was heading toward a shopping center and had my turn signal on. I was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic.
When it looked clear, I started my left turn, and a vehicle coming the other way hit the front passenger side of my car.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you started the turn?
A: I saw headlights a ways off, but I thought there was enough room. I may have misjudged how fast it was moving.
Q: Were you able to get out of the car on your own afterward?
A: Yes, but I felt stiff right away. My neck was sore and my lower back started tightening up within an hour or so.
Q: Have you sought any medical attention since the collision?
A: I went to urgent care the same day. They diagnosed a neck and back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a
referral to a physical therapist.
Q: Are you currently receiving treatment?
A: Yes, I'm doing physical therapy a few times a week. Some days are better than others, and I've had to take time off
from my job because bending and lifting hurts.
Q: Is tehre anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I'm sorry this happened and I want to cooperate fully. I'll send over the urgent care paperwork and my
therapy schedule.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
